entities.name: Mehmet Ali Ülgen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmet Ali Ülgen was a Turkish admiral who served as commander-in-chief of the Turkish Naval Forces from 1 July 1949 to 6 June 1950. He joined the Navy in 1905 after graduating from the Turkish Naval Academy an ensign.
